chunks: Humran asked Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام about the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic.
"Indeed, We sent it down on a blessed night."
He said: "It is Laylat al-Qadr, and it is in every year in the month of Ramadan, in the last ten nights. The Qur'an was not sent down except on Laylat al-Qadr. Allah, Mighty and Majestic, said:"
"In it every wise matter is made distinct."

He said: "On Laylat al-Qadr, every thing that will occur in that year up to the like of it in the coming year is decreed: of good or evil, obedience or disobedience, a newborn, a term of life, or provision. So whatever is decreed on that night and decided is the inevitable, and for Allah, Mighty and Majestic, therein is the will."
He said: I said to him, "Laylat al-Qadr is better than a thousand months"—what did He mean by that?

So he said: "Righteous deed in Laylat al-Qadr—were it not that Allah, Blessed and Exalted, multiplies for the believers, they would not attain; but Allah, Mighty and Majestic, multiplies the good deeds for them."

key_terms.أَمْرٍ حَكِيمٍ: every wise matter, referring to divinely ordered affairs.
key_terms.الْعَمَلَ الصَّالِحَ: righteous deed performed on that night.
key_terms.الْمَشِيئَةُ: the divine will belonging to Allah.
key_terms.لَيْلَةٍ مُبَارَكَةٍ: the blessed night referred to in the verse, identified here as Laylat al-Qadr.
key_terms.لَيْلَةُ الْقَدْرِ: Laylat al-Qadr, the night in which the Qur'an was sent down and yearly matters are decreed.
key_terms.يُفْرَقُ: is distinguished or separated out, meaning matters are made clear and apportioned.
key_terms.يُقَدَّرُ: is decreed or measured out for the coming year.

ai.seo_question: What do the verses about the blessed night and Laylat al-Qadr mean in relation to divine decree and worship?
ai.summary: This hadith explains that the 'blessed night' is Laylat al-Qadr, which recurs every year in Ramadan during the last ten nights. On that night, the matters of the coming year are apportioned by divine decree, and righteous deeds performed then are better than those of a thousand months because Allah multiplies the rewards of the believers.
